push.title: W 3-2 vs JamRock  United | You: 9.2 (top 10% MID)
push.body:
Sweet tea and sunshine, buddskees. A 9.2 against JamRock  United is top 10% for any midfielder out there.

DID WELL
+ A brace against JamRock  United, your 2nd straight match scoring. That's a striker's instinct, and you can't teach that at a clinic.
+ Man of the Match, your 2nd for us. You were the best player on the pitch, and you know it. Now stay humble.
+ That 9.2 is your ceiling now. Let's raise it again.
+ 2.0 better than usual. Proud doesn't cover it.
+ 19 completed passes earned +0.3. That's interest on hard work.

WORK ON
- Only 2 tackles attempted. Quick one: As a CDM/CM, screen the back line: stay between the ball and our goal and pick off passes.
- defensive work rate hit you and BellyTb1 both. Partner drill: pass runners off and track them into the box.
- 4 misplaced passes: -0.1. Little leaks sink big ships.
- Pass accuracy: 83%. Aim for 87%+.
- Passes attempted: 23. Top tier midfielders post 25+. Let's join 'em.

Quick drill: When we lose it, press for 3-5 seconds right away. That's when they're most disorganized.

If I had a gold star sticker, you'd get the whole sheet. - Coach Lasso

An 8.8 against JamRock  United, BellyTb1. If I had a hat I'd tip it, then I'd buy a second hat just to tip that one too.

DID WELL
+ 2 key passes (up from your usual 0). Assists don't make headlines, but they make teams.
+ A goal against JamRock  United. Ball in the net, smile on my face. That's the deal.
+ That connection with buddskees is the real deal. Find 'em early and often.
+ 1.0 up on your norm. Let's make it a habit.
+ That 8.8 ranks top 10% across all midfielders.

WORK ON
- Only 1 tackle attempted. Tiny tweak: Second-ball awareness: after a header or clearance, be the first one to the loose ball.
- 71% passing (17 of 24, down from your usual 79%). Let's try: Before the killer ball, check: is my runner onside, moving, and unmarked? Two out of three isn't enough.
- You and buddskees were in the same boat on defensive work rate. Row together: pass runners off and track them into the box.
- 3 shots off target docked 0.1. Small leak, easy patch.
- Passes attempted: 24. Keep pushing; 25+ is within reach.

Work on: When the ball is lost, the nearest player presses and everyone else closes the passing lanes.

push.title: W 3-2 vs JamRock  United | You: 7.0 (above average FOR)
push.body:
A 7.0, PhogsToffees. You did your job and then some. That's the kind of teammate folks want.

DID WELL
+ 1 key pass. You turned nothing into something more than once.
+ You and buddskees were finishing each other's sentences out there.
+ 3-2 over JamRock  United. Winning's like a good porch swing: easy to get used to.

WORK ON
- 1 of 2 shots on target. Look up before you shoot. Half a second tells you where the keeper's weight is.
- 0.8 under average. You'll be back above it soon enough.
- Pass accuracy: 74%. Push for 88%+ and you're elite company.
- Shots: 2. You're in the conversation. 3+ wins the argument.

Homework: Hit the target first, beat the keeper second. A shot on target can still be saved into a rebound.

Keep your head up and your feet moving. - Coach Lasso
